# sherpa-prompt-composer

An AI prompt input. Auto-growing textarea. Enter submits; Shift+Enter inserts a newline.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | content |
| Built on | the native `<form>`, which gives submit, validation, reset |
| Figma | Prompt Composer |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-prompt-composer/sherpa-prompt-composer.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-prompt-composer/sherpa-prompt-composer.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-prompt-composer/sherpa-prompt-composer.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-prompt-composer/sherpa-prompt-composer.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-prompt-composer/sherpa-prompt-composer.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-prompt-composer placeholder="Message the assistant…"></sherpa-prompt-composer>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-no-leading-actions` | boolean |  | hide the two default leading buttons (attach + lab) |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | disables the input, leading buttons + send button |
| `placeholder` | text, native |  | textarea placeholder |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt-submit` | `{ text: string }` | On a non-empty submit (then clears). |
| `composer-attach` |  | The attach (paperclip) button is pressed. |
| `composer-lab` |  | The lab (flask) button is pressed. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `extras` | control | extra controls after the default leading buttons (reflects has-extras) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`attach`, `extras`, `form`, `input`, `lab`, `leading`, `send`, `tools`
